event_name: NHRA New England Nationals presented by bproauto

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 76 degrees, relative humidity 60 percent, barometer 29.67 inches, adjusted
altitude 2,110 feet, track temperature 96 degrees.

Aaron Stanfield "leaves first" 62.9% of the time.   Jeg Coughlin "leaves first" 61.7% of the time.

Stanfield is 9 - 6 against Coughlin in prior events. 


Stanfield with the starting line advantage, but Coughlin chased him down by 1000 feet for the win in a close
one.  Jeg Coughlin's MOV: 0.0055 seconds (approximately 20 inches).

Greg Stanfield is 109 - 121 in Rd. 1.  Cody Anderson beat Stanfield in Rd. 1 in Gainesville.

Anderson is 1 - 0 against Stanfield in prior events. 

Stanfield with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.

Anderson is out of the groove and the car make a move toward the wall, he does a great job driving.

Matt Hartford has 2 wins and 5 Rd. 1 losses this year.  Deric Kramer is 5 - 7 against Hartford in Rd. 1.

Hartford is 12 - 9 against Kramer in prior events. 

Hartford with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes the quickest pass of the
round.

Dallas Glenn has won 25 consecutive Rd. 1 races.   Shane Tucker set Top Speed at MIR, he is the 84th PS driver
to set Top Speed.

Glenn is 2 - 0 against Tucker in prior events. 

Glenn with a tick advantage on the tree and never trailed for the win in a close one.  Dallas Glenn's MOV:
0.0133 seconds (approximately 4 feet).

Eric Latino has fouled out in 2 of his last 3 races.  Kenny Delco is 2 - 4 in Rd. 1 this year,

Latino is 1 - 0 against Delco in prior events. 

Delco with the starting line advantage, but Latino has the difference made up by the time they go by the
Christmas tree and never trailed from there on for the win.  He will give up lane choice to Hartford in the
next round.

This (#2) is the best starting spot for Matt Latino.  He is 6 - 1 in Rd. 1 this year.  Brandon Miller is
making his 8th start overall (and 3rd this year)

This is the first time Miller and Latino have faced each other in eliminations.

Latino with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He will give up lane choice to Greg
Stanfield in the next round by 0.002 seconds.

Greg Anderson has had 5 Bye runs in Rd. 1 in his career and has only won the race once (Houston, 2016). 


Anderson is straight down the groove with the quickest pass of the round.  He will have lane choice over
Coughlin in the next round.

Erica Enders wins 86% of her Rd. 1 races when she has lane choice.  Troy Coughlin Jr. is 0 - 2 against Enders
in Rd. 1.  Their last Rd. 1 race was in Dallas, 2020.

Enders is 11 - 8 against Coughlin Jr. in prior events.

Enders with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  She will have lane choice over Glenn
in the next round.
